title: Section 17 — Suits for immovable property situate within jurisdiction of different Courts — CPC 1908

content.heading: Suits for immovable property situate within jurisdiction of different Courts
content.text: Where a suit is to obtain relief respecting, or compensation for wrong to, immovable property situate within the jurisdiction of different Courts, the suit may be instituted in any Court within the local limits of whose jurisdiction any portion of the property is situate. The Court may, for reasons recorded, stay the suit so that a suit may be filed in a Court within whose jurisdiction the rest of the property is situate, as enacted.
